notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is here for K2: Digital Edition on Steam!
notes.notes:
The brand-new [b]Avalanche [/b]mini expansion has arrived, bringing fierce weather and fresh challenges. 🌨️ And thanks to [b]Steam Cloud[/b], your progress follows you wherever you climb - from base camp to summit and back again. ☁️🧗

🏔️ While you’ve been scaling peaks, we’ve been fine-tuning the ropes behind the scenes. Check out the full changelog below to see what’s new, and what’s been fixed along the way.

[h3]Version 1.1.0[/h3]
[Feature] Prepare for even tougher climbs! The Avalanche mini expansion is now available, introducing new weather conditions to challenge your ascent.
[QoL] Your progress now travels with you! Automatically back up your saves with Steam Cloud.
[QoL] A new marker shows when a space on the mountain is fully occupied, helping you plan your route more clearly.
[QoL] You can now attach your last save file automatically when submitting a report, making it easier for us to investigate issues.
[Fix] Game now runs at a maximum of 60 FPS to prevent unnecessary GPU heating and reduce energy usage.
[Fix] Fixed an issue where the screen would jump while scrolling on touchscreen devices.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6 is here!
notes.notes:
🚩 [b]K2: Digital Edition[/b] has just been updated - [b]version 1.0.6 is now live and ready to download on Steam[/b], bringing a fresh wave of improvements, fixes, and tweaks that enhance your gameplay. ⛏️

🏔️ We’ve been working hard over the past few days to bring you these updates, and below you can also find the changelog with the previous improvements we’ve made so far:
[h3]Version 1.0.6[/h3]
[QoL] Improved the rulebook for better clarity.
[QoL] Added extra onboarding popups explaining rule modifications.
[QoL] Added an indicator/marker when a space is over-occupied.
[Fix] Fixed a bug where the camera could point into the sky.
[Fix] Fixed various typos.

[h3]Version 1.0.5[/h3]
[Fix] Adjusted the description for the “DeathZone” achievement.

[h3]Version 1.0.4[/h3]
[QoL] Added a popup/label in online multiplayer to clearly show when it’s your turn.
[Fix] Stability improvements and minor bug fixes.
[Fix] Improved photo caption readability.
[Fix] Resolved the “DeathZone” achievement.
[Fix] Fixed Mount Everest Crevasse distribution (previously could cause a soft lock).
[Fix] Hid the Wishlist button in the Pause menu.
[Fix] Minor fixes to Polish translations.

notes.title: K2: Digital Edition Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
🏔️ The wait is over. We’re super excited to reveal that [b]K2: Digital Edition[/b] is officially launching on Steam on [b]29th April, 2025[/b]! 🎉 iOS & Android release details will follow.

And that’s not all - [b]the updated demo is NOW LIVE on Steam[/b]! 🏔️ Based on your amazing feedback, we’ve made a couple of improvements:

🧗 Enhanced visibility and clarity when selecting climbers, making it easier to plan your ascent.
🎨 Adjusted interface scaling for better readability.
🏕️ Added additional tooltips to provide clearer explanations of game mechanics, helping both new and experienced players navigate.
🌦️ Additional Loading Screen quotes.
⚙️ General stability and performance enhancements.
